small_guidance:

- Cache weights once per (oc, ic, kh, kw) outside the HW loop by restructuring: load the full `w_vals` of shape (BLOCK_OC,) once and broadcast against `x_vals`; ensure compiler hoists by using `tl.load` of weight with only `mask_oc` (already done) — verify there is no redundant reissue. Consider pre-loading the entire (BLOCK_OC, IC*KH*KW) weight tile into registers/SMEM once per program.
- Switch input layout to NHWC (channels-last) so the inner IC loop becomes contiguous loads; reshape weight to (OC, KH, KW, IC) at init and iterate ic as the innermost vectorized axis.
large_guidance:
- Rewrite as an implicit-GEMM with M=OC, N=N*OH*OW, K=IC*KH*KW using tl.dot. Tile (BLOCK_M=64, BLOCK_N=64, BLOCK_K=32) and accumulate with mma; current kernel uses scalar FMA via broadcast outer products and leaves tensor cores idle — this is the main reason fast_p≈0.56.
- Use channels-last (NHWC) input and weight reshaped to (OC, KH*KW*IC) so the K dimension is contiguous; gather input through im2col index math inside the K loop, building a (BLOCK_K, BLOCK_N) tile per iteration that feeds tl.dot.
- Fuse bias + ReLU + HardSwish in the epilogue on the accumulator (already correct) and write back in NHWC; perform a single final permute to NCHW if the reference requires that layout — or skip if the downstream consumer is layout-agnostic.
